inactive_metrics.xwoba_against: `xwoba_against`'s minor-league feature is a TRIPLE-A-ONLY Statcast summary, so a player carries it at one level at most and the trajectory delta has ZERO within-player transitions to act on. E7.15-H3 recorded `T1_traj_ladder` and `T2_traj_raw` at EXACTLY 0.000% lift here — the signature of an arm byte-identical to the foil. INACTIVE is a statement about the population's scope, not about the effect; the remedy is a different population, never more seasons (E7.15/NF1.9/MH2).

reproduction_vs_e7_15_h3.note: every shared arm reproduces E7.15-H3's recorded per-fold MAE — the two runs are the SAME evidence, so the field-definition comparison is valid.

k_pct.reason: `k_pct`: the best arm does not beat the foil ON AVERAGE. No sample size rescues a negative point estimate and no field size changes its sign — do NOT re-test.

bb_pct.reason: `bb_pct`: the best arm does not beat the foil ON AVERAGE. No sample size rescues a negative point estimate and no field size changes its sign — do NOT re-test.

hr_rate.reason: `hr_rate`: the winner's per-fold Sharpe 0.018 sits at or BELOW the 3-arm field's deflated benchmark SR0 0.442, so DSR is unreachable at ANY fold count — `n` scales a positive gap, it cannot create one. The remedy is a SMALLER, pre-registered field, not more seasons.
hr_rate.retest_trigger: NOT rescuable by field size either — even a 2-arm field does not clear at this fold count and dispersion, so the only lever left is a lower-variance design (more rows per fold / a sharper metric)

gb_pct.reason: `gb_pct`: the effect is positive and every gate is REACHABLE, but this design cannot resolve it — DSR alone needs 1039 folds against 11 (the BH-FDR requirement is separate and may be larger).
gb_pct.retest_trigger: +1028 folds for the DSR gate — field size alone cannot rescue it at this dispersion

leaderboard.note: ⭐ THE DIRECT-LEARNED FOIL — the shipped E7.12-slice-1 configuration; each row an independent observation, the arm's own shipped weight_col retained
BYTE NO-OP — a constant weight column. Its MAE gap to the foil must be EXACTLY 0; anything else means the harness changed something it did not declare.
the trajectory delta permuted across players within a level — catches 'any dispersed extra regressor helps' rather than the ordering carrying information.
⭐ GENUINELY NEW INFORMATION — the ladder-adjusted rate change from the player's previous level, as a fixed regressor (+ an impute flag). NESTS THE FOIL at coefficient 0.

MATCHED FOIL FOR THE LADDER'S CONTRIBUTION — the same delta computed on RAW rates, which confounds 'the player improved' with 'the level got harder'. If it ties T1, the ladder adds nothing here either.
years-at-level + levels-logged — repeating a level is a scouting-legible negative signal the aggregated box line erases (two identical Double-A lines, one taking three seasons).
DEGENERATE CEILING (NF-D11/NF-D14) — predict the population mean of the target.
